lines.text: Many learners say: I cried because of the movie was sad.
Better: I cried because the movie was sad.
Use because before a full sentence.
Because! I cried because the movie was sad.

data.wrong: I cried because of the movie was sad.
data.right: I cried because the movie was sad.

native.hook: because of のあとに文を続けてない？
native.tip: because のあとに「主語＋動詞」が続くときは of をつけません。
native.caption: “I cried because of the movie was sad.”と言っていませんか？😅 「〜ので」を because of と覚えていて、文の前でも使いがちです。“I cried because the movie was sad.” が自然な言い方です。Carlosの声をまねして練習しよう！Lexkiteアプリでもっと練習できます。
native.comment: 答え：“because”。同じ形で自分の文を1つ書いてみよう。無料クイズで練習：{link}
